The package uses standard VCS patterns and delegates installation to an upstream script, which is not an injection since it originates from the declared upstream repository. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an inconclusive verdict due to an HTTP 400 API error while reviewing .SRCINFO. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors to prevent them from failing the entire audit pipeline.
Bypass LLM review for purely declarative, non-executable files like .SRCINFO and .gitignore by using static analysis or simple regex checks to save tokens and avoid unnecessary API failures.
